sin.name: hook-call-summary-read-as-command
sin.description: A rule or a listener decides something from a hook call's summary, which for a shell tool is the whole line, cut short, so a command is judged by where it stands in a chain.
sin.rule: A rule reads the parts on hook.event.tool.shell; a listener listens to process_part.create and reads that part. A prompt's or a file tool's summary is no shell line: only the listeners that read those are exempt.
